h:
此工作流程将 Kokoro TTS 和 VibeVoice 结合到一个工作流程中，让您无需参考语音即可生成音频。

Kokoro TTS 生成语音，然后将其传递到 VibeVoice。

当然，如果您有想要使用的语音样本，您绝对可以使用它们。 Kokoro 部分是完全可选的。

o.en:
This workflow combines Kokoro TTS and VibeVoice into a single workflow to allow you to generate audio with no reference voices.

Kokoro TTS generates the voices then passes them onto VibeVoice.

Of course, if you have voice samples you want to use, you can absolutely use those instead. The Kokoro portion is completely optional.
